request_user:
Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Agentic workloads (code agents and visual agents, evaluated in agent scaffolds/harnesses), and tool-calling/thinking-mode chat-style systems; the card frames it as improving cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads. No explicit RAG or decision-support use is stated.
quotes: This allows the model to activate only **8B parameters per token during prefill** and **16B during decode**, substantially improving cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads.
For code agent benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1/3.0/4.0, DeepSWE v1.1, NL2Repo-Bench, ProgramBench), the model is evaluated with the Minimal mode of DeepSeek Harness and a 1M-token context window.
Visual agent benchmarks (Chartography, BabyVision, ZeroBench) use the Claude Code harness with a 512k-token context window.
test cases for multi-turn conversations, tool calling, thinking mode, numeric reasoning effort, mid-conversation system messages, and interleaved image content.
